name: charter-conformance-ts
description: The conformance API in TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers: every Fern feature charter uses, in one small API, from an oRPC contract (api/contract.ts). The Worker serves that API the standard way (/api) and is also the harness that runs the generated TypeScript SDK against it inside workerd (/harness/sdk-test). npm run check is every check that needs no Cloudflare account; npm run dev runs it here; npx charter-ts help lists every command.
